_comment: Machine-readable identity of the Occurframe behavioural specification.
The specification versions independently of the tooling, the corpus and the
runner protocol: it is the semantics an implementation is measured against,
not the artefact that measures. This file is the single authoring-side
declaration of that version; the tooling pins the same value once in
release/evidence-lock.json and release packaging fails if the two disagree.
Adding this file changes no vector, no expectation and no canonical digest.

command_doctrine.engine_gate: A named maintainer of a named project commits, in writing and in public, to adopt an Occurframe engine at a specified integration seam.
